BOOK ONE · LESSON 112

How do they compare? 比一比

它们怎么样？比一比。

Lesson 112 is a picture lesson about 'as...as' and 'not as...as' comparisons. Eighteen pictures (a-r) show pairs of things compared using as...as (sweet, tall, short, old, blunt, sharp) and not as...as (clean, fat, smart, light, new, expensive), followed by examples of difficult/more difficult/most difficult and interesting/less interesting/least interesting. The written exercises and grammar workbook section focus on age, weight and height comparisons using as...as and not as...as.

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

听录音并回答问题。

As...as (a-f): sweet, tall, short, old, blunt, sharp. Not as...as (g-l): clean, fat, smart, light, new, expensive. Examples (m-r): difficult / more difficult / most difficult; interesting / less interesting / least interesting.

像……一样（a-f）：甜的、高的、矮的、老的、钝的、锋利的。不像……一样（g-l）：干净的、胖的、聪明的、轻的、新的、贵的。例句（m-r）：难的/更难的/最难的；有趣的/没那么有趣的/最没趣的。

Listen and answer the questions

Listen to the recording and answer the questions for each picture (a-r).

听录音并回答每组图片（a-r）的问题。

The recording reads comparisons for each picture pair.
